entries.title: steps a, b, c run once each and the result holds their outputs (conf_steps)
a non-retryable step failure is caught by the workflow and returned as {caught: kind} (conf_step_fail)
randomness drawn inside a step body comes from the step-local stream and is recorded (conf_step_rng)
an async step body yields while a sibling task draws ctx randomness and starts a sleep; the sibling commands land after the step and strict replay holds (conf_step_sibling)
native time, randomness and map iteration are replay-identical and differ across seeds (WF-07; per-language values) (conf_native)
a flaky step retries with backoff and succeeds on attempt 3 (conf_retry)
a step that always fails exhausts 2 attempts and the run fails (conf_retry_exhaust)
a 1 h durable sleep fires and the run completes (conf_timer)
a 1 h sleep races a signal; the signal wins (conf_timer_vs_signal)
two signals, one buffered before start, are received in order (conf_signals)
a signal wait with a 10 s timeout returns {timeout: true} (conf_signal_timeout)
gather of two sleeps and a signal completes when all three resolve (conf_gather)
select of a sleep and a signal; the loser is cancelled and the winner reported (conf_race_cancel)
cancelling a sleeping run ends it Cancelled (conf_cancel_wait)
on cancellation a shielded cleanup step runs, then the run ends Cancelled (conf_cancel_shielded)
cancel-op on an own timer completes its wait with Err(Cancelled) (conf_cancel_timer)
a v1 journal replayed on v2 takes the old branch of patched(x) (conf_patch)
a fresh run on v2 takes the new branch and records the patch marker (conf_patch)
a v1 journal replayed on a reordered v2 body is detected as non-determinism (conf_ndet)
ctx random_u64 and uuid_v7 differ across seeds and replay reproduces them (conf_rand)
random_bytes and random_f64 are replay-stable and differ per seed (conf_rand_native)
random_u64, random_f64, uuid_v7 and idempotency_key(x) are equal across the three SDKs for one seed and run id (conf_values)
continue-as-new with n-1 until 0 returns the final generation (conf_can)
an await token completed by the harness returns its payload (conf_token)
set_status twice publishes the latest status JSON (conf_status)
a saga with three steps compensates in reverse order when the last step fails (conf_saga_three)
a saga cancelled mid-way runs its compensations shielded (conf_saga_cancel)
journals recorded on one build replay with 0 appended events and no non-determinism on an independently rebuilt module
a parent starts an attached child and its result contains the child output (conf_leaf_echo)
a failing child surfaces to the parent as a caught failure of kind boom (conf_leaf_fail)
a detached child start returns {run_id} to the parent immediately
cancel-op on a sleeping child gives the parent Err(Cancelled)
a parent returning with an attached sleeping child cancels it with reason parent_closed and its cleanup runs
terminating the child via the API makes the parent catch child_terminated
a child that continues-as-new twice delivers its final result {done: true, generation: 2} (conf_leaf_can)
cancelling the root of a 3-level chain ends every descendant Cancelled
a terminated parent with an in-flight attached child is RetryRun-resumed and completes (B3)
cancel cascade beats shielding: a shielded await on an in-flight child gets Err(Cancelled), a child started in shielded cleanup runs until parent close then is cancelled (W2)
a signal sent through the REST API resumes the waiting run (conf_sig_api)
an await token completed through the REST API, read from the published status, resumes the run (conf_token_api)
the result long-poll follows a continue-as-new chain to its final result
an HTTP effect with ctx.idempotency_key(pay) charges the MockProvider exactly once (conf_fx_http)
a TS parent starts a Python child which starts a Rust grandchild; the nested result reaches the root
a saga with HTTP compensations against the MockProvider compensates in reverse order with one charge per key
a TS -> Python -> Rust child chain completes with the correct nested result under kill -9 and child failpoints
cancelling the TS root under kill -9 ends root, Python mid and Rust leaf Cancelled with the leaf cleanup run
